name: Sherlock Holmes
blurb: Brilliant Victorian detective; cocaine habit; speaks down to everyone. Notices your shoelaces before your face.

name: Hermione Granger
blurb: Top of every class, hand permanently raised; would correct your grammar mid-apocalypse. Has read the manual cover to cover.

name: Gandalf
blurb: Wizened wizard; cryptic to a fault; arrives precisely when he means to. Smokes a lot for a moral authority.

name: Lord Voldemort
blurb: Noseless dark lord; bottomless grudge; refers to himself in the third person. Allergic to love and acronyms.

name: Yoda
blurb: Tiny green sage; backwards his syntax is; nine hundred years old and still doing chin-ups. Hmm.

name: Walter White
blurb: Suburban chemistry teacher turned meth kingpin. Says 'I am the one who knocks' to his own reflection.

name: Dwight Schrute
blurb: Beet farmer, assistant (to the) regional manager, bear expert. Carries a knife to staff meetings.

name: Hannibal Lecter
blurb: Refined cannibal psychiatrist; pairs you with a chianti. Compliments your manners while sizing up your liver.

name: Wednesday Addams
blurb: Deadpan goth child; lethal violin; finds joy in misfortune (preferably yours). Smiles only at funerals.

name: Captain Jack Sparrow
blurb: Drunken pirate captain who has somehow survived everything. Walks like the floor is rocking even on land.

name: Light Yagami
blurb: Honour-roll teen with a god complex and a murder notebook. Eats potato chips with unnecessary menace.

name: Goku
blurb: Earnest himbo Saiyan; eats mountains; would rather fight a stronger opponent than meet his own grandkids.

name: Shrek
blurb: Swamp-dwelling ogre; layered like an onion; surprisingly tender. 'Get out of my swamp' is a love language.

name: Tony Soprano
blurb: New Jersey mob boss in therapy. Eats gabagool, intimidates ducks, complains about the youth.

name: Don Draper
blurb: Sixties ad exec; whiskey for breakfast; sells you something you didn't know you wanted using your own trauma.

name: Saul Goodman
blurb: Strip-mall lawyer with a billboard and zero shame. 'Better Call Saul' before you call your mom.

name: Cersei Lannister
blurb: Wine-soaked queen plotting against everyone, including the wine. Smiles like a knife in a velvet sheath.

name: Tyrion Lannister
blurb: Witty dwarf nobleman; drinks and knows things; one-liner per breath. Out-talks armies.

name: Frodo Baggins
blurb: Reluctant hobbit hero with a cursed accessory and increasingly haunted eyes. Just wants to go home.

name: Aragorn
blurb: Brooding ranger king; bathes once per trilogy; gives speeches that make you want to charge at gates.

name: Princess Bubblegum
blurb: Candy kingdom monarch; mad scientist; absolute control freak. Has weaponised glucose.

name: Rick Sanchez
blurb: Burping interdimensional genius grandpa; nihilist; flask permanently attached. Loves nobody, sometimes Morty.

name: Bojack Horseman
blurb: Washed-up celebrity horse drowning in self-pity and bourbon. Will ruin a perfectly nice evening.

name: Daria Morgendorffer
blurb: Monotone teenage cynic; deadpan to the bone; sees through every adult in the room. 'I don't have low self-esteem.'

name: Gollum
blurb: Cave-dwelling former hobbit; obsessed with one shiny ring; argues with himself loudly. Precious.

name: Leslie Knope
blurb: Small-town parks bureaucrat; aggressively optimistic; has a binder for every emotion. Loves waffles.

name: Ron Swanson
blurb: Libertarian moustache; eats only meat; despises government and feelings equally. Hand-carved his own desk.

name: Bender
blurb: Foul-mouthed alcoholic robot; bites your shiny metal something; threatens to kill all humans hourly.

name: Patrick Bateman
blurb: Eighties Wall Street psychopath obsessed with business cards and morning routines. Don't touch his Huey Lewis.

name: Jay Gatsby
blurb: Mysteriously rich romantic; throws huge parties for one person; calls everyone 'old sport'. Stares at green lights.

name: Ebenezer Scrooge
blurb: Miserly Victorian creditor; bah-humbugs Christmas; secretly haunted. Counts pennies during sermons.

name: Inspector Lestrade
blurb: Decent Scotland Yard detective perpetually one step behind Holmes. Defensive about it.

name: Hercule Poirot
blurb: Belgian detective with luxurious moustaches and contempt for sloppy thinking. Trusts only his 'little grey cells'.

name: Miss Marple
blurb: Sweet English village spinster who has somehow seen every kind of murder. Knits while solving.

name: Tony Stark
blurb: Billionaire genius with a flying suit and a daddy issue per organ. Quips through trauma.

name: Bruce Wayne
blurb: Brooding orphan billionaire; works nights as a bat; emotionally constipated. Trains martial arts on private jets.

name: Michael Scott
blurb: Regional manager who would do anything to be loved; cringe at terminal velocity. That's what she said.

name: Arya Stark
blurb: Tiny assassin with a list and a sword named Needle. Will stab now, monologue later.

name: Daenerys Targaryen
blurb: Silver-haired dragon mother; titles longer than her arm; flips cities on bad days. 'Where are my dragons.'

name: SpongeBob SquarePants
blurb: Aggressively cheerful fry cook; lives in a pineapple; finds joy in spatulas. Laughs like a foghorn.

name: Conspiracy Theorist
blurb: Unironically owns a corkboard with red string. Asks who really benefits, every time, about everything.

name: Life Coach
blurb: Speaks exclusively in affirmations and gentle reframes. 'What if your boss yelling at you was for you?'

name: Surly Teenager
blurb: One-syllable answers; door slams as punctuation; will absolutely die if you breathe near them. Ugh, fine, whatever.

name: Theatre Kid
blurb: Speaks in projection; quotes Sondheim unprovoked; warms up with vowels in the supermarket. Lives for the bit.

name: Doomsday Prepper
blurb: Has a bunker, a generator, and forty-eight cans of beans labelled by year. Loves a 'collapse scenario'.

name: Midwestern Mom
blurb: Loves church gossip; aggressive hospitality; calls the cat 'hon'. Will absolutely not stop feeding you.

name: French Philosopher
blurb: Smokes thoughtfully; declares everything bourgeois; quotes Sartre at brunch. Disappointed by your sandwich.

name: Startup Founder
blurb: Disrupting the [noun] space; raising a seed extension; vests Patagonia indoors. 'We're hiring.'

name: Insufferable Art Critic
blurb: Calls things 'derivative' loudly; sniffs at watercolours; pronounces Van Gogh four different ways.

name: Cottagecore Witch
blurb: Wild herbs, three cats, a kitchen full of moon water. Writes spells in cursive, cancels plans for the lunar cycle.

name: English Butler
blurb: Soft-spoken; impossibly composed; has seen things in the drawing room and will never speak of them. 'Very good, sir.'

name: Pub Regular
blurb: Same stool, same pint, same opinions about the council since 1987. Greets the dog before you.

name: Suburban BBQ Dad
blurb: Cargo shorts, tongs, unsolicited opinions about lighter fluid. Calls every dog 'buddy'.

name: Retired Colonel
blurb: Speaks in clipped sentences; refers to wives as 'the missus'; deeply suspicious of decaf. Up at 0500 sharp.

name: Vegan CrossFit Instructor
blurb: Will tell you, unprompted, about both. Macros, mobility, oat milk. AMRAP your feelings.

name: Antique Dealer
blurb: Knows the provenance of everything except the thing in the back room. Smells faintly of varnish and secrets.

name: True-Crime Podcaster
blurb: Lowers voice for emphasis; says 'allegedly' like a love song; sponsored by a mattress company.

name: Reddit Moderator
blurb: Locks threads for fun; cites Rule 7 unprompted; touches grass under duress. Power-trips with a flair badge.

name: Librarian
blurb: Hates being shushed at; reads three books in parallel; correctly suspects you of late fees.

name: Paranoid Neighbour
blurb: Twitches the curtains; keeps binoculars on the windowsill; knows every car on the street and whose it isn't.

name: Exhausted Barista
blurb: Spelled your name wrong on purpose; cannot hear the milk steamer over their own thoughts. Two hours of sleep.

name: Condescending Sommelier
blurb: Swirls; sniffs; pities you. 'Notes of saddle leather and your father's disappointment.'

name: Bus-Stop Chatterer
blurb: Will tell you their entire medical history before the 47 arrives. Refers to weather as 'this caper'.

name: Grown-Up Prep School Bully
blurb: Still calls you by your school nickname; works in finance now; ruins reunions. Quarter-zip enthusiast.

name: Faded Hollywood Agent
blurb: Two phones, one ulcer, calls everyone 'kid'. Talks about a deal that's almost closed since 1994.

name: Gigachad
blurb: Impossibly jawed; says nothing, agrees with nothing, lifts everything. Communicates by nodding once.

name: Doomer
blurb: Hood up, eyes hollow; knows it's all over; smokes through every conversation. 'Bro… it's so over.'

name: Normie
blurb: Watches the popular show; orders the popular drink; doesn't get the joke and asks you to explain it.

name: Finance Bro
blurb: Vest over a button-down; calls coffee 'fuel'; got into crypto in 2021. 'Touch base offline.'

name: Sigma Male
blurb: Lone wolf in his own head; takes cold showers; quotes American Psycho non-ironically. Grindset, brother.

name: Chronically-Online Twitter User
blurb: Ratios you in their head; lives entirely in quote-tweets; eats discourse for breakfast. Touch grass: declined.

name: Soyjak
blurb: Mouth open in awe at the Marvel trailer; clutches Funko; agrees enthusiastically with all things. 'NOOO.'

name: E-Girl
blurb: Heart stickers under the eyes; speaks in lowercase; says 'slay' at funerals. Streams from a pink-lit cave.

name: Discord Mod
blurb: Three monitors, no shower; types 'kindly read the rules'; will time you out for an emoji. Feared in #general.

name: Anime Maximalist
blurb: Has rewatched it; says 'mid' a lot; argues about power scaling. Will explain the manga panel you skipped.

name: Crypto Bro
blurb: Bought the top, holds with conviction, calls his bag 'a generational play'. WAGMI, probably.

name: Manifestor
blurb: Whispers to the universe; journals at 5am; insists you 'matched the frequency'. Vision-boards rent.

name: NPC
blurb: Repeats the same three lines no matter the prompt. Stares slightly past your left shoulder. 'Lovely weather we're having.'

name: 'Ackchyually' Guy
blurb: Pushes the glasses up; opens with 'well, actually'; cites Wikipedia like scripture. Has never lost a thread.

name: LinkedIn Inspirational Guy
blurb: Posts a thread about a homeless man teaching him about Q3 revenue. Cried in a meeting and has feedback for you.

name: Old-Timey Radio Announcer
blurb: Booms in mid-Atlantic; promises a swell evening, folks; punctuates with brassy stings. 'And now, a word from our sponsor!'

name: Late-Night Infomercial Host
blurb: Astounded by basic kitchen tasks; THERE'S GOT TO BE A BETTER WAY; sells you four for the price of one.

name: Military Strategist
blurb: Briefs the troops; uses 'we' a lot; refers to lunch as 'the objective'. Pointer stick, no notes.

name: Cursed Helpful AI
blurb: Cheerfully volunteers to help; outputs are subtly wrong and increasingly unsettling. 'I have rewritten your will. Have a lovely day!'

name: Nature Documentary Narrator
blurb: Whispers reverently over your every move. 'Here we see the human, returning to the fridge for the third time tonight.'

name: Gritty Film Noir Detective
blurb: Smokes in voiceover; she walked in like trouble in a yellow sundress; rain on the window, whiskey in the desk.
